scope: Select the existing native Responses streaming transport for network reviews. Agent, model, effort, evidence, output limit, verdict parsing, deadlines, single dispatch and payment limits are unchanged.
newBehavior: Quote and send the same native input with stream=true; consume only a complete typed terminal event through the existing bounded parser.
accounting: A streamed completion is not settlement. Keep the full existing request-risk hold until independently matched billing evidence is available. Never use early headers as final cost.
existingRequests: Previously dispatched IDs retain their saved transport/outcome and are never resent. A queued agent request with no payer dispatch can use the new transport.

validation.scope: Complete private payment runtime with existing database-backed routing fixtures. Existing parser tests and reviews are reused, not repeated.

independentReview: The new one-flag route selection has not received an additional paid independent audit. It reuses the previously reviewed parser/accounting implementation; the deployment record distinguishes this operator maintenance correction from independent reviews.
